observations.detail: All declared hashes matched. The runtime-imported predecessor also matched its producer-recorded hash, but it is absent from this handoff's inputs, source_bindings and queue read_scope.
The final snapshot's producer suite is not passing: 2 of 10 cases error before exercising isolation.
X+1 over F5 is rejected by the Rabin routine, and degree-one modulus selection exhausts. The mandatory k=1 bin cannot execute.

The substring blacklist accepts a withheld scalar carried under an unrecognised context key; the dishonest-input control checks its own inserted key without passing the object through the actual audit boundary.

Fresh labels are drawn inside every q/block/repeat loop, so q=1 is not the q=64 prefix and repeated blocks do not reuse the fixed workload. Raw order labels alternate while evaluator execution always runs curve BSGS first.

Fixture and field construction receive the same interval, field/T setup is incomplete, three setup-table fields remain zero, evaluator reconstruction occurs before timing, and no per-q/per-cell ratios, medians, operation counts, RSS or table/output bytes are produced.
A subprocess timeout raises RunInterrupted without killing the started process group, despite the error claiming that group termination occurred.

A mocked valid signature caused the verifier to accept a Bedrock, model-unverified runtime. The signed lock need not bind the implementation approval, transitive predecessor, run id, implementation commit or dirty state.
A one-cell mocked panel with no mandatory calibration is marked completed_pending_review. The manifest permits null commit/dirty/RSS, records an incomplete command and emits no metrics.
SearchExhausted is classified invalid_measurement/failed with empty fixture progress, contrary to the frozen partial/inconclusive branch.
Only evaluator children receive address-space/process limits. The main run has no wall/CPU/RSS enforcement or signal checkpoint and writes one package only after the full in-memory pipeline exits.
A complete mock package publishes all twelve declared files through one same-directory rename and refuses a second write to the same canonical run directory.
